Ola Electric faces insolvency petitions from suppliers

Ola Electric's share price saw a slight dip following reports of insolvency petitions filed by two suppliers over alleged unpaid dues. The company's stock opened at ₹42.41, a marginal increase from its previous close of ₹42.39. This development raises questions about the company's financial health and its relationships with its suppliers.
